title: Unit – 2 : Session – 6 : SLO – 2 | Arguments and Parameters (MCQ)
sections: 1. Actual argument → b) A value or variable passed during a method call
2. Formal parameter → d) A variable listed in the method signature to receive input
3. Java's mechanism → d) Pass by value
4. Primitive passed to a method → b) It gets modified only inside the method (the caller's copy is unchanged)
5. Arrays passed to methods → a) Arrays are passed by reference value (the reference is copied), and changes to elements reflect outside the method
